en: The *Fahua xuanyi* (Profound Meaning of the Lotus Sūtra),
ten fascicles, spoken by the Great Master Zhiyi of Tiantai, recorded and presented by the Great Dharma Master Xuanni of Enryaku-ji in accordance with the Imperial Edict of the Sage King.

*Fahua xuanyi shiqian* (Sub-commentary on the Profound Meaning of the Lotus Sutra), ten fascicles; composed by Master Zhanran of Jingxi. *Fahua xuanyi kewen* (Outline of the Profound Meaning of the Lotus Sutra), one fascicle; composed by Zhanran.
*Fahua wenju shangjuan* (The First Fascicle of the Textual Commentary on the Lotus Sutra); preached by Master Zhizhe, with a preface by Shenhui.

*Fahua wenju shuji* (Commentary and Notes on the Textual Commentary on the Lotus Sutra), ten fascicles; composed by Zhanran. *Fahua wenju kewen* (Outline of the Textual Commentary on the Lotus Sutra), one fascicle; composed by Zhanran.

However, there are: two fascicles of the *Fahua jing shu* (Commentary on the Lotus Sutra) by [Zhiyi]; one fascicle of the *Fahua guanyin pin xuanyi* (Profound Meaning of the "Avalokiteśvara" Chapter of the Lotus Sutra);

two fascicles of the *Fahua guanyin pin shu* (Commentary on the "Avalokiteśvara" Chapter of the Lotus Sutra) by Zhiyi; one fascicle of the *Fahua guanyin pin kewen* (Outline of the "Avalokiteśvara" Chapter of the Lotus Sutra) by Zhiyi;
one fascicle of the *Fahua dayi* (Great Meaning of the Lotus Sutra) by Zhanran; and one fascicle of the *Fahua dayi* by Mingkuang.
*Shufa hua chanfa* (A Description of the Lotus Repentance Method), one fascicle; *Zhizhe shuo fahua sanmei bubozhi yi* (The Ritual for Assisting the Lotus Samādhi Spoken by Zhizhe), one fascicle;

*Zhanran shu fahua shu* (Zhanran’s Commentary on the Lotus Sūtra), four fascicles; *Shanggong Wang yuzhi fahua wenju sizhiji* (The Imperial Record of the Personal Notes on the Words and Phrases of the Lotus Sūtra composed by Emperor Shanggong), fifteen fascicles;
*Zhiyun shu fahua wenju ji* (Zhiyun’s Record of the Words and Phrases of the Lotus Sūtra), six fascicles; *Dinglin shu fahua wubai wen* (Dinglin’s Five Hundred Questions on the Lotus Sūtra).

*Treatise in Three Volumes*, composed by Zhànrán; *Diagram of the Threefold Cycle of the Lotus Sūtra in One Volume*; *The Peaceful Practices in One Volume*, both composed by the Great Master of Nanyue;
*Meaning of the Ten Non-Dual Gates in One Volume*, composed by the Monk Zhìguān; *Explanation of the Meaning of the Ten Suchnesses in One Volume*;
*Aid to Illumination of the Lotus Sūtra in Three Volumes*, composed by Chuánjiào; *Eliminating Delusions through the Lotus Sūtra in Four Volumes*, composed by Chuánjiào.

*Fahua shuji* (Commentary on the Lotus Sutra), three fascicles; composed by Zhizhe Dashi. *Fahua zhu shi* (Explanations of the Lotus Sutra), fourteen fascicles; composed by Zhizhe Dashi. *Fahua shu* (Commentary on the Lotus Sutra), two fascicles;

composed by Zhu Daosheng. *Yuantun zhiguan* (Complete and Sudden Calming and Contemplation), ten fascicles; expounded by Zhiyi Dashi. *Mohe zhiguan* (Mahā-śamatha-vipaśyanā), ten fascicles; expounded by Zhiyi Dashi.
*Mohe zhiguan fuxing zhuanhong jue* (Decisions for the Propagation of the Mahā-śamatha-vipaśyanā), ten fascicles; composed by Zhanran.

*Mahā-śamatha-vipaśyanā Hongjue Souyao ji* (Essential Notes on the Expansive Decisions of the Mahā-śamatha-vipaśyanā), ten fascicles; composed by Zhanran. *Mahā-śamatha-vipaśyanā Wenzhu* (Commentary on the Text of the Mahā-śamatha-vipaśyanā), two fascicles;

composed by Zhanran. *Mahā-śamatha-vipaśyanā Yili* (Principles and Examples of the Mahā-śamatha-vipaśyanā), one fascicle; composed by Zhanran. *Mahā-śamatha-vipaśyanā Xinyao* (Essentials of the Mind of the Mahā-śamatha-vipaśyanā), one fascicle;
composed by Zhanran. *Mahā-śamatha-vipaśyanā Zhushu* (Annotations and Explanations of the Mahā-śamatha-vipaśyanā), thirty fascicles; composed by Guangzhi. *Mahā-śamatha-vipaśyanā* [itself].
*Yinyi* (Explanations of Terms and Meanings), one fascicle; *Dagyi Mohe Zhiguan* (Great Outline of the Mahā-śamatha-vipaśyanā), one fascicle, composed by Zhanran;

*Mohe Zhiguan Bajiao Dagyi* (Great Outline of the Eight Teachings of the Mahā-śamatha-vipaśyanā), one fascicle, composed by Mingkuang; *Mohe Zhiguan Kewen* (Outline of the Mahā-śamatha-vipaśyanā), one fascicle;

*Mohe Zhiguan Sande Tu* (Diagram of the Three Virtues of the Mahā-śamatha-vipaśyanā), one fascicle; *Bajiao Tu* (Diagram of the Eight Teachings), one fascicle; *Lüezhiguan* (Abridged Śamatha-vipaśyanā), six fascicles, composed by Liang Su; *Xiaozhiguan* (Minor Śamatha-vipaśyanā).

*Guān'èrjuàn Zhìzhě shuō zhǐguān jì zhōng yìyì yījuàn* (One fascicle on variant meanings within the *Commentary on the Śamatha and Vipaśyanā Spoken by the Great Master in Two Fascicles*), recorded by Dàsuì;

*Qiánshū jí chánmén xiūzhèng* (Ten fascicles on the Cultivation and Realization of the Chan Gate, compiled by Qiánshū); *Zhìzhě shuō chánmén zhāng yījuàn* (One fascicle on the Chapter on the Chan Gate Spoken by the Great Master); *Zhìzhě shuō chánmén yàolüè yījuàn* (One fascicle on the Essential Summary of the Chan Gate Spoken by the Great Master);

*Zhìzhě shuō xiūchán liùmiàomén yījuàn* (One fascicle on the Six Sublime Gates of Cultivating Meditation Spoken by the Great Master); *Zhìzhě shuō liùmiàomén wén* (The Text on the Six Sublime Gates Spoken by the Great Master).

*Jù* (Verses), one fascicle; *Lüeshì liùmiàomén* (Brief Explanation of the Six Sublime Gates), one fascicle; *Zhìzhě shuō kǒujié chánfǎ* (The Master’s Oral Instructions on the Dharma of Meditation), one fascicle;

*Zhìzhě shuō sìniànchù* (The Master’s Exposition on the Four Foundations of Mindfulness), four fascicles; *Zhìzhě shuō guānxīnlùn* (The Master’s Treatise on the Contemplation of the Mind), one fascicle; *Zhìzhě shuō guānxīnlùn shū* (Commentary on the Master’s Treatise on the Contemplation of the Mind), two fascicles;
*Guǎngǐng shù juéyì sānmèi* (Guǎngǐng’s Account of the Samādhi of the Enlightened Mind), one fascicle; *Zhìzhě shuō juéyì sānmèi* (The Master’s Exposition on the Samādhi of the Enlightened Mind).

*Wenju* (Textual Explanations), one fascicle; *Zhizhen shu wuzheng sanmei famen* (The Dharma Gate of the Samādhi of Non-contention Expounded by Zhizhen), two fascicles; *Nanyue shu zaguangxing* (Miscellaneous Contemplative Practices Expounded by Nanyue), one fascicle;

*Zhiye shuo guanxin songjing ji* (Record of the Contemplation of Mind and Chanting of Sutras Spoken by Zhiyi), one fascicle; *Zhizhen shu jinguangming jing chanfa* (The Repentance Method for the *Suvarṇaprabhāsa-sūtra* Expounded by Zhizhen), one fascicle;
*Zhiye shu xiusanmei changxingfa* (The Method for Constant Practice of Cultivating Samādhi Expounded by Zhiyi), one fascicle; *Dacheng* (Mahāyāna), [one fascicle].

*Zhiguan* (Cessation and Contemplation), one fascicle; composed by Nanyue. *The Forty-two Letter Gate*, two fascicles; composed by Nanyue. *The Successive Stages of the Dharma Realm*, three fascicles; composed by Zhiyi.
*The Method of Great Vehicle Seated Meditation*, one fascicle; composed by Bodhidharma. *Samādhi Following One’s Own Intent*, one fascicle; composed at Mount Tai.
*The Meaning of the Six Stages of Perfection in the Complete Teaching*, one fascicle; expounded by Zhiyi. *The Meaning of the Six Stages of Perfection*, one fascicle.

Six fascicles of the *Weimojing xuanshu* (Profound Commentary on the Vimalakīrti Sūtra) composed by Xingman; twenty-eight fascicles of the *Weimo jiangshi shu* (Lecturer’s Commentary on the Vimalakīrti) spoken by Zhiyi;

ten fascicles of the *Weimo jiangshi lüeshu* (Abridged Lecturer’s Commentary on the Vimalakīrti) spoken by Zhiyi; six fascicles of the *Weimo jiangshi shuji* (Recorded Notes on the Vimalakīrti Commentary) composed by Zhanran;

three fascicles of the *Weimo jiangshi siji* (Private Notes on the Vimalakīrti Commentary) composed by Zhanran; one fascicle of the *Weimo xuanshu ji* (Notes on the Vimalakīrti Profound Commentary) composed by Daoxian.
*The Exposition of the Meanings of the Four Teachings* in twelve fascicles, narrated by Xian; *The Exposition of the Meaning of the Three Contemplations* in two fascicles, spoken by Zhiyi;
*A Text for Judging the Disputes on the Four Teachings of Tiantai* in one fascicle, spoken by Zhiyi; *Commentary on the Vimalakīrti Sūtra* in three fascicles;

*Categories of the Vimalakīrti Sūtra* in one fascicle, composed by Emperor Shanggong; *Commentary on the Vimalakīrti Sūtra* in six fascicles; and *Commentary on the Nirvāṇa Sūtra* in fifteen fascicles, narrated by Faxian.

*Jie-duan shu niepan zai-zhi shu* (Commentary on the Re-examination of the Nirvāṇa Sūtra) in fifteen fascicles, composed by Guanding; *Niepan shu ji* (Record of the Commentary on the Nirvāṇa Sūtra) in nine fascicles, composed by Zhànrán;

*Niepan shu si-ji* (Private Record of the Commentary on the Nirvāṇa Sūtra) in five fascicles, composed by Dàoxiān; *Niepan si-zhi ji* (Private Record of the Intent of the Nirvāṇa Sūtra) in one hundred and fifteen fascicles, composed by Hángmǎn;
*Niepan xuanyi* (Profound Meaning of the Nirvāṇa Sūtra) in one fascicle, composed by Wèidào; and *Niepan xuanyi* (Profound Meaning of the Nirvāṇa Sūtra), composed by Zhìyún.

*Wenju* (Textual Explanations), one fascicle; *Niepan kewen* (Outline of the Nirvāṇa Sūtra), five fascicles, composed by Daoxian; *Niepan houfen kewen* (Outline of the Latter Part of the Nirvāṇa Sūtra), one fascicle;
*Niepan yinyi* (Phonology and Meaning of the Nirvāṇa Sūtra), one fascicle, composed by Zhanran; *Niepan yinyi* (Phonology and Meaning of the Nirvāṇa Sūtra), one fascicle, composed by Xingman;

*Niepan shuchao* (Commentary on the Nirvāṇa Sūtra), five fascicles, composed by Faxuan; *Niepan shuchao* (Commentary on the Nirvāṇa Sūtra), one fascicle, composed by Daoxian; [and further works] composed by Faxuan.
*Jinbi lun* (The Golden Scalpel Treatise), one fascicle, composed by Zhànrán. *Jinbi lun ji* (Record of the Golden Scalpel Treatise), one fascicle, composed by Míngkuàng.
*Jinbi lun kewén* (Outline of the Golden Scalpel Treatise), one fascicle, composed by Chuánjiào. *Jinbi lun zhùshì* (Commentary on the Golden Scalpel Treatise), one fascicle, composed by Chuánjiào.

*Jinguāngming jīng zhùshì* (Commentary on the *Suvarṇaprabhāsa-sūtra*), five fascicles, composed by Chuánjiào. *Jinguāngming wénjù* (Words and Phrases of the *Suvarṇaprabhāsa-sūtra*), three fascicles, spoken by Zhìzhě. *Jinguāngming* (The *Suvarṇaprabhāsa-sūtra*).

*Jinguangming jing xuanyi shu* (Commentary on the Profound Meaning of the *Suvarṇaprabhāsa-sūtra*), three fascicles; expounded by Zhiyi. *Huayan jing gumu* (Skeleton Outline of the *Avataṃsaka-sūtra*), one fascicle; composed by Zhiyi.

*Huayan fajie guan* (Contemplation of the Dharma-realm of the *Avataṃsaka-sūtra*), one fascicle; composed by Zhizhan. *Fangguang jing yiji* (Record of the Meaning of the *Brahmajāla-sūtra*), two fascicles.

*Fangguang jing shu* (Commentary on the *Brahmajāla-sūtra*), one fascicle; expounded by Zhiyi. *Qing guanyin jing shu* (Commentary on the *Avalokiteśvara-bodhisattva-pūrvapraṇidhāna-sūtra*), one fascicle; composed by Mingkuang. Expounded by Zhiyi.
One fascicle of the *Commentary on the Sūtra of Contemplation of the Buddha of Immeasurable Life* by Zhiyi; one fascicle of the *Commentary on the Amitābha Sūtra* by Zhiyi;
one fascicle of the *Resolution of Ten Doubts regarding the Amitābha Sūtra* by Zhiyi; three fascicles of the *Commentary on the Benevolent Kings Sūtra* composed by Zhànrán;
one fascicle of the *Commentary on the Benevolent Kings Sūtra* composed by Chuánjiào; and three fascicles of the *Private Notes on the Benevolent Kings Sūtra* composed by Chuánjiào; [and] Guǎngdìng.
*Renwang jing shu* (Commentary on the Benevolent Kings Sutra) in four fascicles, composed by Guanding; *Renwang jing shu* in two fascicles, composed by Daoyi;

*Jingang banruo boluomi jing shu* (Commentary on the Diamond Prajñāpāramitā Sūtra) in one fascicle, composed by Daozhi; *Mile chengfo jing shu* (Commentary on the Maitreya’s Attainment of Buddhahood Sūtra) in five fascicles, expounded by Zhiyi;

*Dazhidu lun shu* (Commentary on the Mahāprajñāpāramitā-śāstra) in twenty-four fascicles, expounded by Zhiyi; *Guanshin shi yiqie jing yi* (Explanation of the Meaning of All Sutras through the Contemplation of the Mind) in one fascicle, composed by Huiying. Zhi.
*The Profound Meaning of All Sutras*, one fascicle, spoken by the Great Master Zhi; *The Meaning of the Seven Types of Awakened Persons*, one fascicle, spoken by the Great Master Zhi;

*The Meaning of the Seven Expedient Means*, one fascicle, spoken by the Great Master Zhi; *The Dharma for Contemplating the Mind and Reciting the Twelve Divisions of the Canon*, one fascicle, spoken by the Great Master Zhi;
*The Practice of the Pratyutpanna Samādhi*, one fascicle, spoken by the Great Master Zhi; *The One, Two, Three, and Four Bodies*, [one fascicle], spoken by the Great Master Zhi.
*Yì yī juǎn* (Meaning in One Scroll), spoken by Zhìzhě; *Wǔ fāngbiàn yì yī juǎn* (Meaning of the Five Expedient Means in One Scroll), spoken by Zhìzhě;

*Shòu púsà jì wén yī juǎn* (Text on Receiving the Bodhisattva Precepts in One Scroll), composed by Nányuè; *Shòu púsà jì wén yī juǎn* (Text on Receiving the Bodhisattva Precepts in One Scroll), composed by Zhànrán; *Fāyuàn wén yī juǎn* (Text on Making Vows in One Scroll), composed by Nányuè;
*Qǐ sìshí'èr xiánshèng yí yī juǎn* (Ritual for Invoking the Forty-two Worthies and Sages in One Scroll), composed by Zhànrán; *Tiāntái Guōqīng bǎi...* [text truncated]

Recorded in five fascicles; *Treatise on the Manifestation of Precepts* by Guanding in two fascicles; *Account of the Origins of the Treatise on the Manifestation of Precepts* by Zhizhe (Dengyō Daishi) in two fascicles;
*Treatise Resolving Provisional and Ultimate Truths* by Zhizhe in one fascicle; *Mirror Illuminating Provisional and Ultimate Truths* by Zhizhe in one fascicle;
*Collection of Scriptural Authorities for Tiantai* by Zhizhe in one fascicle; *Commentary on the Vajraśekhara Sūtra* by Zhizhe in seven fascicles; [Compiled by] Qing.
*Susiddhikara-sūtra-ṭīkā*, seven fascicles, composed by Jingang Qingjing (淨金剛); *Hetuvidyā-praveśa-nyāya-śāstra-ṭīkā-ṭippaṇī*, two fascicles, composed by Qinggan (清幹);
*Rakṣā-rājya-pariccheda*, nine fascicles, composed by Zhuanjiao (傳教); *Zhao lun shu* (Commentary on the *Treatise of Zhaolun*), three fascicles;
*Zhao lun si ji* (Private Record of the *Treatise of Zhaolun*), one fascicle; *Śrīmālā-devī-siṃhanāda-sūtra-ṭīkā*, two fascicles, composed by Shanggong (上宮).
*Private Notes on the Meaning of the King’s Autocommentary on the Śrīmālā-sūtra*, one fascicle; *Biographies of Miraculous Responses at Tiantai*, one fascicle, both composed by Mingkong;

*The Great Meaning of the Tiantai School*, one fascicle, composed by Zhizhe (Chuanjiao); *Contemplation for Entering the Path of Mahāyāna*, one fascicle, composed by Kumārajīva; *Great Meaning of Kumārajīva*, three fascicles;
*Sub-commentary on the Commentary of the Immeasurable Meanings Sūtra*, three fascicles, composed by Zhizhe (Chuanjiao); *Golden...* [text truncated].
*Kangbian zong* (Distinguishing the Tenets) in three fascicles; *Daoshen*’s *Guansin youxin koujue ji* (Record of Oral Instructions on Contemplating the Mind and Roaming the Mind) in one fascicle;

*Zhiyi’s* *Shuo pusa shichong sijushi qingjie* (Explanation of the Ten Major and Forty-eight Minor Precepts for Bodhisattvas) in one fascicle; *Nanyue Tiantai shan ji* (Record of Nanyue and Tiantai Mountains) in one fascicle;

*Fulong daochang ji* (Record of the Fulong Practice Site) in one fascicle; Liang Su’s *Shisi ke yishu* (Commentary on the Fourteen Sections of Meaning) in two fascicles; and Qinggan’s *Shi...* [incomplete].

One fascicle of the *Sī-yì-sū-shù-chāo* (Explanatory Commentary on the Meaning of the Four Sections), composed by Qinggan; one fascicle of the *Fó-shòu-kŭ-jué-yì* (The Meaning of Resolving the Buddha’s Suffering);

one fascicle of the *Sì-zú-jìng-wén* (Recorded Sayings of the Four Schools); and one fascicle of the *Lìemíng-kāiméng-chūxué-zuòchán-zhǐguān-yàomén* (Brief Clarification of the Essential Gate of Sitting Meditation and Calm Contemplation for Beginners to Dispel Ignorance), composed by Jingbian—totaling one hundred and eighty-one works in six hundred and forty-two fascicles.
